description: Space-to-space delivery, where there is no ground keep-out volume and no human intruder to budget against. RESERVED: v0.1 is scoped to space-to-ground and this profile has not had a hazard analysis. See OBJECTIONS.md O-8.

rationale.tokenLifetimeS: The intruder budget of [R-S-024] does not apply without a ground keep-out volume. The binding constraint for space-to-space is relative velocity against a cooperative receiver, which this document has not analysed. 30 s is a placeholder and is NOT derived.
